rationale: One major test gap found (CR-001): test_exhausted_retries_raises does not assert call_count, so it cannot detect regressions in retry count (a change to 0 retries would still pass). All other acceptance criteria pass. Two deferred observations: stop_after_attempt semantic matches the spec's 'total attempt count' definition and mirrors base_datasource_processor.py; connection-level errors are out of spec scope. Dismissed: import-time decorator evaluation (tests handle it correctly). Three lenses ran successfully; all standards checks pass.

business_review.criterion: Retry uses exponential backoff with STORAGE_CONFIG knobs
business_review.notes: stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential min/max all read from STORAGE_CONFIG; matches base_datasource_processor.py pattern.

business_review.criterion: Non-retryable errors (4xx) fail immediately on first attempt
business_review.notes: _is_transient_http_error returns False for any status not in {502, 503, 504}.

business_review.criterion: After retries exhausted, original HTTPError is reraised
Successful retry after initial 504 allows indexing to continue
business_review.notes: test_retries_on_504_then_succeeds verifies call_count == 2 and correct return values.

business_review.criterion: Three mock-based tests: successful retry, exhausted retries, non-retryable error
business_review.notes: All three tests exist but test_exhausted_retries_raises does not assert call_count — cannot distinguish 'retried then raised' from 'raised immediately'.
No existing test injects 502/503/504; TestLazyLoad patches _search_content_by_cql at method level, bypassing the decorator.

standards_review.notes: Both commits use EPMCDME-14732: prefix matching the EPMCDME-####: Description convention.
make ruff passed with all checks passed.
stdlib (logging, typing) → third-party (requests, langchain, tenacity) → first-party (codemie) order maintained.
No credentials, no unsafe handling; before_sleep_log logs timing only.

findings.problem: test_exhausted_retries_raises does not assert mock_confluence_client.get.call_count. With indexing_max_retries=2, the method should be called exactly 2 times before raising. Without this assertion the test passes even if a regression causes the decorator to skip retrying and raise on attempt 1.
findings.impact: The retry-count contract is untested. Any future change that collapses retries to zero would pass the test suite silently.
findings.recommendation: Add 'assert mock_confluence_client.get.call_count == STORAGE_CONFIG.indexing_max_retries' (or the concrete value 2) after the pytest.raises block — mirroring how test_non_retryable_error_fails_immediately already guards call_count == 1.
